title: I think my SIM was swapped fraudulently — what should I do immediately?
content:
Question: I think my SIM was swapped fraudulently — what should I do immediately?

Answer: Call our 24x7 fraud helpline immediately to block the SIM, then visit a store with ID to reissue a verified SIM. Also alert your bank if the number is linked to banking OTPs, and file a complaint with local cyber-crime authorities.

Topic: Security & Fraud
